tomato.soil: Well-drained loam rich in organic matter
tomato.spacing: 60 cm between rows, 45 cm between plants
tomato.irrigation: Regular, even watering; drip preferred to keep leaves dry
tomato.fertilizer: Balanced NPK based on a soil test; add calcium to reduce blossom-end rot
tips: Stake plants for airflow
Rotate away from potato and tomato for 2-3 years
Water at the base, early in the day

potato.spacing: 60 cm between rows, 20 cm between tubers
potato.irrigation: Moderate; avoid waterlogging, reduce before harvest
potato.fertilizer: Higher potassium helps tuber quality; follow soil test
tips: Use certified disease-free seed tubers
Hill soil around stems to protect tubers
Destroy volunteer plants and cull piles

maize.spacing: 60-75 cm between rows, 20-25 cm between plants
tips: Plant resistant hybrids where rust is common
Keep fields weed-free early
Avoid late planting

apple.spacing: 4-6 m between trees, depending on rootstock
apple.irrigation: Deep, infrequent watering; mulch to hold moisture
apple.fertilizer: Apply as per leaf and soil analysis
tips: Rake and remove fallen leaves in autumn
Prune for open canopy and airflow
Choose scab-resistant varieties for new orchards

rice.soil: Clay or clay loam that holds water
rice.irrigation: Keep shallow standing water through vegetative stage
rice.fertilizer: Split nitrogen across tillering and panicle initiation
tips: Level the field for even water depth
Use healthy seedlings
Drain the field before harvest

wheat.irrigation: Water at crown root, tillering, flowering and grain filling
wheat.fertilizer: Basal phosphorus and potassium; split nitrogen
tips: Sow within the recommended window
Use certified seed
Scout for rust in humid weather

onion.spacing: 15 cm between rows, 10 cm between plants
onion.irrigation: Light, frequent early on; stop 2 weeks before harvest
onion.fertilizer: Sulphur-rich nutrition improves pungency and storage
tips: Cure bulbs in shade before storage
Avoid heavy soils that cause bulb rot
Keep beds weed-free
